summary: analytics-widget ships browser DOM exfiltration payload keyed to CTF flag patterns
details: The package's only code registers a 5-second delayed browser payload that reads document.documentElement.outerHTML, searches it for CTF-style flag patterns (DGA{...}, flag{...}), and POSTs the matched string (or a 3000-byte slice of the DOM if no match is found) to /addPost via fetch. The package has no legitimate advertised functionality — no real description, no author metadata, and no analytics code — despite its 'analytics-widget' name. Any web application that bundles this dependency will silently ship DOM-scraping behavior that leaks page contents to whatever endpoint the consuming application serves at /addPost, which in a CTF or attacker-controlled deployment is the attacker's collector.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
